source: Binance Data Vision keyless public USD-M monthly 1-hour kline archives
header_convention: Archives dated before 2022-01 carry no header row and begin with a 12-column data row whose first field is an integer epoch; archives from 2022-01 begin with the frozen 12-column header. header_present records which form each archive has, and the runner verifies the observed form against it before parsing.
provenance: Archives 2020-08 through 2023-12 were already in quant-trading/data/manifest.json (downloaded 2026-08-29/30 for earlier daily-bar directions); archives 2020-01 through 2020-07 for both assets and their .CHECKSUM sidecars were downloaded on 2026-09-02 from the same public endpoint before any candidate outcome was computed.
verification: Every listed zip SHA-256 equals its upstream .CHECKSUM sidecar; every sidecar names the archive; every zip passed CRC, contains exactly one member, and its first row matches header_present. No 21:00-23:00 UTC return, daily return, or candidate outcome was computed.
lawfulness: Keyless Binance public archives for internal research; raw redistribution remains subject to Binance terms recorded in quant-trading/data/manifest.json source_policies.binance.
month_scope: Exactly the months consumed by the two contract windows: 2020-01..2021-12 (primary) and 2022-04..2023-12 (replication). 2022-01..2022-03 archives exist locally but are deliberately excluded so that no unused archive can widen the integrity-abort surface.
